title: DevX SDK daily scratchpad — doc gaps & sample app TODOs
content:
Quick notes from today (scratchpad)

Context: triaging doc gaps for SDK GA; focus areas = quickstart, streaming example, function-calling sample app, troubleshooting section for private deployments. Small scope fixes to unblock onboarding flow.

Top priorities (this sprint)
- Quickstart walkthrough (README -> step-by-step): current README assumes env already set up. Need: 1) minimal local run w/ env vars, 2) example request + response (sync + streaming).
  - Action: write minimal quickstart md with copy-paste commands. (owner: me)
  - Blocker: API key example — we should avoid literal keys; use REDWOOD_API_KEY env var snippet.
- Streaming example for chat: users confused about SSE vs WS handling in Node/py. Add both examples and streaming-to-ui notes.
  - Owner: Samantha to draft Node example, I’ll do Python async generator.
- Function / tool-calling sample app: repo has partial example but not end-to-end (missing backend routing + mock tool). Build a tiny sample app repo (2 files) that: 1) shows registration of tools, 2) call flow, 3) call reroute when tool fails.
  - Owner: Devon (backend scaffolding) + me (docs + example README).
- Troubleshooting for Private deployments: common error patterns (KMS permissions, NAT egress, cert trust). Capture latest notes from infra SRE.

Doc gaps noticed (short list)
- Missing: "rate limit best practices" for batching + retries. Users ask whether to backoff or drop requests. Need recommendation table (per-tier defaults).
- Missing: examples of quantization/parameter tradeoffs in SDK config (how to choose model variant at call-time).
- CLI examples inconsistent across docs (some use `redwood` binary, others `rw` in examples). Standardize to `rw` across docs and add note about aliases.
- Error code mapping page: a lot of internal errors surfaced; map to user-level actionable suggestions (ex: 409 -> retry with smaller batch).

Small TODOs (quick wins)
- [ ] Add copy-paste quickstart.md to SDK repo root (10–20m) — include sync + streaming examples.
- [ ] Update README code samples to use env var pattern.
- [ ] Add note in streaming section about chunking and UI flushing.
- [ ] Create tiny sample app skeleton under /examples/function-calling/README.md with run steps.
- [ ] Link troubleshooting KMS article from private-deployments docs. (ask SRE for latest doc link)
- [ ] Fix typo in SDK auth docs: `auth_header` -> `authorization_header` (line ~143).

Conversation / context snippets to capture
- From Slack (#devx-sdk): "users hitting weird 400 when streaming large initial prompt; likely chunking or request-size limit" — need to add recommended max prompt size and fallback suggestion.
- From PR #452 (GH): streaming example updated but missing instructions for client side handling of partial tokens. Add a short blurb and link to websocket example.

Risks / questions
- Do we want to publish the function-calling sample app in the main examples dir or keep it as a separate mini-repo? Separate repo easier to iterate but increases discoverability friction. Suggest: add both — a small snapshot in main repo + link to full example-repo.
- For private deployments troubleshooting, are we allowed to include configuration snippets that mention customer network ranges? no — sanitize any customer-specific values.

Notes to self (next steps)
- Draft quickstart.md comp tomorrow morning; drop into PR and ping @mikaela for review.
- Collect SRE notes on KMS + NAT by EOD Thurs. Ticketed as JIRA-DEVX-1283 (linked).
- Pair w/ Samantha for Node streaming example Tues 10am.
- Draft function-calling example minimal README + run script; open PR and link sample app issue in PR description.

Misc scratch (brain dump)
- Consider short "common pitfalls" FAQ for SDK landing page (1 pager): auth, streaming, batching, function-calls, private deploy gotchas. Could reduce support tickets by ~15%.
- Idea: embed a tiny interactive playground in docs (web sandbox) that runs against sandbox keys. Need security review but would be killer for onboarding.

Related links to capture:
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-sdk/pull/452
- Jira: JIRA-DEVX-1283 (private deploy troubleshooting)
- Confluence notes: CONFLUENCE-DEVX-742 (streaming patterns)

End of scratchpad.

---
Small rough / choppy notes kept intentionally — will clean into structured PR description when ready.
